label: Distributed Systems & Cloud Architecture
brief: Create five clean, futuristic distributed systems vectors: Raft consensus quorum, event stream pipeline, mesh gossip network, circuit breaker, and load balancer fanout.

items.name: Raft Consensus Quorum
items.description: Consensus cluster with central elected leader synchronizing follower nodes.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a distributed consensus cluster with a glowing leader node broadcasting heartbeat synchronization pulses to four surrounding replica nodes; no text.

items.name: Event Stream Pipeline
items.description: Partitioned message stream pipeline with sequenced event packets.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a linear segmented event pipeline with sequenced glowing data packets streaming into partitioned consumer lanes; no text.

items.name: Gossip Mesh Network
items.description: Decentralized peer-to-peer mesh network propagating gossip protocols.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a decentralized geometric mesh network graph with interconnected peer nodes and subtle radiating propagation rings; no text.

items.name: Circuit Breaker Pattern
items.description: Electrical switch circuit breaker illustrating fault-tolerant isolating mechanism.
items.generation_prompt: Draw an elegant geometric circuit breaker switch mechanism with protective status nodes and clean contact terminals; no text.

items.name: Load Balancer Fanout
items.description: Ingress gateway node distributing incoming traffic streams across replica pools.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a central ingress router node branching and load-balancing a single incoming flux stream evenly into three parallel worker nodes; no text.
